title: 44 yoshida yangi do'kon ochgan savdogar kim edi?
hook: 44 yoshida u yangi turdagi do'kon ochdi.

scenes.text: 1962 yilda 44 yoshli savdogar Arkanzas shtatidagi kichik Rojers shahrida yangi do'kon ochdi.
Undan oldin u 1945 yildan boshqa shaharda do'kon yuritgan. 1950 yilda ijara uzaytirilmadi va u do'kondan ayrildi.
U taslim bo'lmadi. Boshqa shaharga ko'chib, savdoni qaytadan boshladi.
Bu odam Sem Uolton edi. 1962 yilda ochilgan do'koni Walmart deb nomlandi.
Bugun Walmart daromad bo'yicha dunyodagi eng yirik kompaniyalardan biri.

description:
Sem Uolton 1945 yildan Nyuport shahrida do'kon yuritgan va 1950 yilda ijara uzaytirilmagani uchun undan ayrilgan. Bentonvillda qaytadan boshlagan va 1962 yilda, 44 yoshida, Rojers shahrida birinchi Walmart do'konini ochgan.

Noldan boshlash uchun kech bo'ladimi? Izohda fikringizni yozing.
source: Web fact-check 2026-11-20 (web search summaries; Wikipedia and Encyclopedia of Arkansas could not be opened from this session). Walmart corporate (corporate.walmart.com/about/sam-walton) and Encyclopedia of Arkansas (first Wal-Mart Discount City opened 2 July 1962 in Rogers; Walton born 29 March 1918, so age 44); Walmart museum account and EBSCO (Newport Ben Franklin store 1945, landlord refused to renew the lease, Bentonville store bought May 1950; one outlet says 1951, most say 1950); PBS NewsHour, Wikipedia, Oklahoma Encyclopedia (Waltons owned about 15-16 Ben Franklin stores by 1962). Fixes: Newport to Bentonville is not a neighbouring town; 'noldan boshladi' at 44 was misleading because he already ran about 15 stores.
